## AI portfolio proof checklist

For each artifact:

- [ ] Specific user and problem
- [ ] Clear personal contribution
- [ ] AI's role disclosed
- [ ] Tools and data sources stated
- [ ] Sensitive data removed
- [ ] Human review documented
- [ ] Test cases included
- [ ] Failure or limitation shown
- [ ] Result measured or observable
- [ ] Current claim matches evidence level
- [ ] Setup or demo is inspectable
- [ ] Accessibility considered
- [ ] No employer/client confidentiality breach
- [ ] No inflated title or production claim

## Resume bullet rewrite guide

### Evidence-first formula

```text
[Strong verb] + [specific workflow/problem] + [method or tool]
+ [quality/verification method] + [defensible result or artifact]
```

### Weak to stronger

```text
Weak:
Experienced with ChatGPT and AI automation.

Stronger:
Designed a repeatable, human-reviewed prompt workflow for converting public policy pages into plain-language checklists; tested typical, missing-source, and conflicting-source cases.
```

```text
Weak:
Built an AI agent that saves hours.

Stronger, when no time study exists:
Built a prototype that routes sample requests into a review queue and documented tool permissions, failure states, and manual approval steps.
```

```text
Stronger, only with recorded measurement:
Reduced average preparation time from [baseline] to [result] across [sample size] while retaining [required review]; measurement method: [method].
```

### Verb calibration

| Evidence | Safer verbs |
|---|---|
| Course or guided exercise | practiced, completed, explored |
| Personal prototype | built, prototyped, tested |
| Documented workflow | designed, documented, evaluated |
| Real-user pilot | piloted, supported, measured |
| Approved production ownership | deployed, operated, maintained |

Do not use “deployed” for a local demo or “led” for solo coursework.

## 30-day career sprint template

```markdown
# Thirty-Day AI Career Sprint

## Target direction

## Evidence gap to close

## Artifact to build

## Weekly plan

| Week | Work | Evidence by week's end | Capacity fallback |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Research target and define proof | Opportunity map and artifact brief | Analyze three postings |
| 2 | Build and test | Working slice and failure log | Complete one test case |
| 3 | Package truthfully | Case study, demo, resume bullet | Draft the problem/method section |
| 4 | Use in reality | Applications, outreach, or workplace feedback log | Send one approved message |

## Metrics

Track:

- artifacts completed;
- representative opportunities reviewed;
- applications or conversations;
- responses;
- interviews or next steps;
- repeated objections;
- schedule fit.

Do not treat application count as the only measure.
```
